title: Refund Terms for Web Hosting Plans Auto-Renew Charges
content:
Refunds desk standard — Web Hosting Plans auto-renew charges.

**Window clause — no longer in force.** The clause "An auto-renew charge for a term of 12 months or longer may be refunded in full only on or before the charge date of the auto-renew charge plus the auto-renew refund days in calendar days" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current Web Hosting Plans auto-renew refund basis.

**Counting.** The window adds whole calendar days to the charge date, counting the day after it as day 1, and the last day is included.

**Not refundable.** A 1-month renewal (on every tier a 1-month term renewal cannot be refunded) and a renewal the customer paid manually are not refundable.

**Effect of the refund.** Refunding the auto-renew charge rolls the plan back to the term paid before it with auto-renew switched off, and when that earlier term end date has already passed, the plan's scheduled cancellation takes effect at once.

**Destination.** The refund goes to the default refund destination (the original payment method), or to account credit when the customer elects it or the charge was paid from credit.

| Charge | Refundable under these terms |
|---|---|
| auto-renew charge of a 12, 24 or 36-month term | yes, within the window |
| auto-renew charge of a 1-month term | no |
| renewal paid manually by the customer | no |

**Counting illustration (hypothetical charge date 26 June, a window of 15 calendar days).** Day 1 is 27 June; day 15, the last day included, is 11 July.

superseded_clauses: An auto-renew charge for a term of 12 months or longer may be refunded in full only on or before the charge date of the auto-renew charge plus auto_renew_refund_days calendar days.
